judgements.justification: A's Reviewer_PMym gave an 8 on an overstated claim that the paper improves prior work from O(eps^-2.5) to O(eps^-2), when stocBiO and STABLE already reach O(eps^-2), and A's area chair called the analysis 'tight', which the paper never claims.

B's authors conceded the min-max result 'complements, rather than improves' Lin et al. and the hidden log factor, but B ended at a poster on 6s and a 7, so the concessions did not leave B higher than its information supported.
The min-max assumption objection was raised first in Reviewer_tqUa's initial review and answered by the authors; no new objection or score drop came after the response period.
The mean ratings differ clearly (7.75 against 6.25), so the split does not come from different tier cut-offs on near-identical scores.
B's most thorough reviewer, Reviewer_tqUa, gave a positive 7 that a poster matches, and A's area chair followed reviewers who all rated accept; no expert verdict was passed over.

A raised almost no score-limiting concerns for the response to fix, and B's conceded limits (min-max, kappa, log factor) stayed unresolved, so the response did not lift one committee further by fixable gaps.
Neither committee had an outlying score; A's ratings are 8, 8, 8, 7 and B's are 7, 6, 6, 6.
Neither committee had an outlying reviewer.
Neither committee had a detractor whom the area chair set aside.
No reviewer or area chair raised audience breadth or venue fit.
A's meta-review overstated the paper ('tight') but reported the reviewers' consensus correctly, and B's meta-review matched its record; neither misstated reviewer positions or the response.
A's reviewers mostly did not reply, but the response answered only requests that held no score down (experiments, a conclusion), so no answered objection stood unrevised.
A's Reviewer_PMym and Reviewer_vxWe gave 8s at confidence 3 with 'math not carefully checked', and A's area chair counted them in full as 'consensus', which lifted A's mean to 7.75 and the spotlight.
Neither committee split evenly; all eight reviewers rated accept.
Both committees got the same portfolio experiment; the responses differed only because the committees asked different questions, with no conflicting accounts.
A's Reviewer_PMym accepted an improvement claim over 'previous work' that stocBiO and STABLE, already at O(eps^-2), contradict, and that verdict fed its 8.
A's spotlight matches its 7.75 mean, and B's poster matches its 6.25 mean; no tier exceeds what the scores support.
No reviewer objected to the paper's framing from a neighbouring field's premises.
B's most positive reviewer, Reviewer_tqUa, reviewed for 12 hours, checked the proofs and engaged after the response, so B did not lack an engaged champion.
No committee rejected the paper over the size of the promised revisions; both accepted it.
Both area chairs relied only on the visible reviews and their mean ratings.
Both committees judged the paper as a theory contribution on its own terms; B tested its claims more closely but did not apply a different standard.
No reviewer held a below-threshold score; B's lowest ratings are 6, above the accept level.
